output.description: Checks the ERC-20 allowance a wallet has granted to a spender and, if it is non-zero, sends a transaction setting it to zero, revoking the spender's permission to move the token. After a revocation it also appends a record (timestamp, addresses, previous allowance, tx hash) to a local revocation log file.
output.declaring_phrase: appends a record (timestamp, addresses, previous allowance, tx hash) to a local revocation log file
